description.value: BierCraft UniverCity is a craft beer restaurant and pub located in the SFU UniverCity neighbourhood on Burnaby Mountain, offering 26 Belgian and craft beers on draught alongside a full food menu covering lunch, dinner, brunch, and kids options. It occupies a community-hub role at the top of one of the Lower Mainland's more demanding cycling climbs, making it a natural endpoint or mid-tour refuelling stop. The venue also screens major sporting events and runs a beer loyalty programme.
